_comment: Declarative bank-SMS pattern rules, shared verbatim by the Dart parser (lib/services/sms/local_sms_parser.dart) and the Kotlin parser (android/app/src/main/kotlin/.../LocalSmsParser.kt) so both interpreters extract identical fields from identical input. Populated in full as part of the local deterministic SMS parser work; this skeleton only carries the coarse prefilter keywords migrated from BankSmsFilter so both languages can agree on the prefilter without duplicating the list by hand.
